name: explorer-flipbook
description: Record of the libraries vendored into vendor/. Not needed to run the viewer — there is no build step and no runtime dependency on npm.

scripts.vendor: npm install && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs vendor/pdfjs/ && cp node_modules/page-flip/dist/js/page-flip.browser.js vendor/page-flip/
